quarantine: ImmPort — confirm not in knowledge-training before eval use
method: from arm_or_cohort descriptions filtered to genuine treatment-withdrawal/taper/tolerance-induction designs; for each, endpoint built ONLY from a named documented outcome column (no wrong-column guessing).

SDY2195.name: ACE / ALE06 (ITN) — myasthenia gravis, mycophenolate mofetil withdrawal
SDY2195.endpoint: time to clinical flare after MMF withdrawal (flarmstr FLAR_FLAROCC/MILDDIS/SEVDIS); time=FLAR_ASMTDY

SDY2274.name: ITN059AI PAUSE — plaque psoriasis, ustekinumab withdrawal
SDY2274.endpoint: time to PASI relapse after UST withdrawal (ADRELAPSE 'Did PASI Score Meet Relapse Criterion'=Y); time=Study Day of Study Termination (relapse triggers early termination) else DISCDY
SDY2274.caveat: relapse date column present but not a clean study-day; termination day used as event time (tight coupling: relapse => early termination)

SDY2275.name: ITN055AI CALIBRATE — proliferative lupus nephritis, therapy taper (belimumab add-on RCT)
SDY2275.endpoint: time to renal flare (dsmstr DSDECOD ~ 'renal flare'); time=DSSTDY (disposition study day)
SDY2275.caveat: renal flare is one of several disposition reasons; other early-withdrawal reasons treated as censoring

SDY1490.name: iWITH / ITN823ST — pediatric liver transplant IS withdrawal
SDY1490.endpoint: time to on-study biopsy-proven rejection (liv3mstr positive REJDY)

SDY3265.name: abatacept + Euro-lupus, proliferative lupus nephritis
SDY3265.reason: flare STATUS available (flarmstr FLAREYN) but ALL dates [Redacted]; only numeric field is a form/phase code — no time-to-event. Binary flare outcome only.
SDY3265.needed: a study-day / relapse-day column (de-identified) — not present in released files

SDY1231.name: CTOT-09 — renal transplant, CNI (tacrolimus) withdrawal
SDY1231.reason: standard-schema intervention timing present (START/END_DAY) giving therapy DURATION, but biopsy-proven-rejection / graft-loss EVENT not resolved from pulled tables
SDY1231.needed: rejection/graft outcome file + data dictionary (grafmstr/his_r_ctot09 present in study dir; parse required)

SDY133.name: SW01 — pediatric renal transplant, steroid withdrawal
SDY133.reason: intervention timing present; rejection endpoint in study-specific files (SW01_rj1.txt / SW01_ptld.rej.txt) not yet parsed to a per-subject time
SDY133.needed: parse SW01_rj1.txt rejection dates + SW01_dt1/enr for follow-up window

SDY3271.name: A-WISH / ITN030ST — liver transplant IS withdrawal vs maintenance
SDY3271.reason: intervention timing present + adsl3/ids1mstr/termmstr; rejection event day not resolved from pulled tables
SDY3271.needed: parse ids1mstr / adsl3 for rejection + termmstr follow-up

SDY857.name: CTOT-11 — kidney transplant, rapid steroid taper (belatacept)
SDY857.reason: intervention timing present; rejection endpoint not resolved from pulled tables

SDY662.name: liver transplant — gradual IS withdrawal (tolerance cohort)
SDY662.reason: only 16 files in study dir; no per-subject outcome timing pulled; likely omics-only deposit

SDY546.name: operationally tolerant liver transplant (cross-sectional 'Tolerant' cohort)
SDY546.reason: cross-sectional tolerant-vs-not phenotype, not a withdrawal time-to-event design
SDY546.needed: n/a — not a longitudinal withdrawal endpoint

SDY3089.name: ATG+rituximab induction with staged IS withdrawal (transplant)
SDY3089.reason: disc/term/stermstr files present but event day not resolved; very small n=14

SDY3274.name: renal transplant recipients (cross-sectional, mixed IS regimens)
SDY3274.reason: only 6 files; cross-sectional enrollment 'regardless of regimen', not a withdrawal trial

SDY218.name: egg oral immunotherapy (food-allergy desensitization)
SDY218.reason: 0 clinical files in study dir; oral-immunotherapy tolerance, off-topic for IS-withdrawal duration

SDY2015.name: peanut-sensitized tolerant infants (cohort)
SDY2015.reason: 0 clinical files; cross-sectional tolerance phenotype, not withdrawal time-to-event

verdict: Therapy-duration is a REAL but SMALL, HETEROGENEOUS objective. Beyond iWITH, only 3 more ImmPort withdrawal studies yield a clean patient-level time-to-event with a documented endpoint (SDY2195, SDY2274, SDY2275): +253 subjects, +48 events. With iWITH: 4 studies, 341 subjects, 87 events. The events span DIFFERENT diseases/endpoints (liver-tx rejection, MG flare, psoriasis PASI relapse, lupus renal flare) — pooling requires a common 'sustained-response-after-withdrawal' abstraction, which is a modeling hypothesis, not a given. ~5 transplant CNI/steroid-withdrawal studies (SDY1231/133/3271/857/3089) are CONSTRUCTIBLE IN PRINCIPLE (intervention timing present) but need per-study rejection-outcome parsing + data dictionaries to resolve the event day — a bounded follow-up effort that could roughly double N. As a standalone FM-training target the N is far too small; as an EXTERNAL VALIDATION set for a derived durability/tolerance score it is usable but must stay study-held-out and disease-stratified.
caveats: small n per study; endpoints are heterogeneous across diseases — do not silently pool
each endpoint built from a documented column; wrong-column guessing explicitly avoided (iWITH lesson)
SDY2275/SDY2195 have built-in control/maintenance arms — usable as within-study null baselines
partial-constructible transplant studies need outcome-file parsing, not yet done here
